banner.hint: Link them in place — no re-download, nothing is copied.

linkExisting.description: Point Story Forge at a Vintage Story install folder. The folder is registered in place — nothing is copied or moved.
linkExisting.folderHint: The folder should contain the game files (Vintagestory, Vintagestory.exe or Vintage Story.app).
linkExisting.nameHint: Used when choosing a version for a profile; the folder name is a good default.
linkExisting.selectFolderTitle: Select a Vintage Story installation folder
linkExisting.title: Link an existing version

row.deleteNote: Profiles using this version keep working; you just cannot create new ones with it until it is reinstalled.
row.folderMissing: Folder not found — relink or unlink it
